title_hi: 12.5 मी. से ऊँचे भवनों में लिफ्ट
interpretation_notes: 'More than 12.5 meters' is read as strictly greater than 12.5 m. Design details follow NBC Part VIII Section 5, which is outside the supplied sources.

source.quote: Provision for lifts shall be made for building more than 12.5 meters in height.

checks.explain_en: Buildings taller than 12.5 m must provide lifts (Rule 83).
checks.explain_hi: 12.5 मी. से ऊँचे भवनों में लिफ्ट का प्रावधान आवश्यक है (नियम 83)।

checks.title_en: Lift design standard (NBC Part VIII, Section 5)
checks.title_hi: लिफ्ट डिज़ाइन मानक (NBC भाग VIII, खंड 5)
notes_en: NBC is not part of the supplied sources.
notes_hi: NBC दिए गए स्रोतों में शामिल नहीं है।

source.quote: Planning, design, installation, operation, maintenance and inspection of Lift, Escalator or Moving Walk to be installed in a building shall be in accordance with the provisions given in Section 5 of Part-VIII: of National Building Code (NBC).

checks.explain_en: Lift planning, design, installation and maintenance must follow NBC Part VIII Section 5 (Rule 83).
checks.explain_hi: लिफ्ट की योजना, डिज़ाइन, स्थापना और रखरखाव NBC भाग VIII खंड 5 के अनुसार होना चाहिए (नियम 83)।

checks.title_en: Lift details with the building permission application
checks.title_hi: भवन अनुज्ञा आवेदन के साथ लिफ्ट का विवरण

source.quote: Every owner shall furnish details related to installation of lift, escalator or moving walk along with building permission application in Appendix A- 2(A) to the concerned authority.

checks.explain_en: Lift installation details go with the building permission application in Appendix A-2(A) (Rule 83(1)).
checks.explain_hi: लिफ्ट स्थापना का विवरण भवन अनुज्ञा आवेदन के साथ परिशिष्ट A-2(A) में देना होगा (नियम 83(1))।
